screenSummary.playArea: Function graph with the bounds a and b and a partition of [a, b], filled by the chosen rule. Area below the axis counts as negative.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose a function and a rule, drag the bounds, set a number of equal subintervals, or split, merge and move single borders.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Pick a function and a rule, drag a and b, then refine the partition and compare the estimates.

screenSummary.playArea: Log–log graph of the error of five rules as the number of subintervals doubles.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose a function, halve or double the subintervals, or try the challenge.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Double n. Which rule’s error falls fastest, and by what factor?

lesson.errorNote: Both axes are logarithmic. A rule whose error falls along a line of slope −p shrinks its error like 1/n<sup>p</sup>: order p. Doubling n then divides the error by 2<sup>p</sup>.
lesson.tooFew: Not yet: the error is still too large.
lesson.tooMany: That works, but fewer would too.
lesson.totalArea: Total area: sum |f| instead of f
